AUTOMATION

#### Automate your workflows

Go beyond out-of-the-box solutions with custom automations that adapt to the way your team works best.

[Discover automation](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/building-automations/)

## Extend Atlassian, your way

Create apps and AI agents with powerful, developer-grade tools

![Image 5: Develop with Forge](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/develop-with-forge.svg)

CUSTOMIZE AND EXTEND

### Develop with Forge

Build, deploy, and host custom apps on Forge. Unlock deep extensibility with developer-grade tools with built-in security and effortless scaling.

![Image 6: Forge CLI icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Art.svg)

#### Forge CLI

Install the Forge CLI to create, test, and deploy apps right from your terminal.

[Start building](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/cli-reference/)

![Image 7: Atlassian MCP server icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/AceRichIcon.svg)

#### UI Kit

Use pre-built, customizable components to craft app experiences that look and feel native to Atlassian.

[Explore UI Kit](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/user-interface/)

![Image 8: Tutorials and guides icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Guidelines.svg)

#### Tutorials and guides

Build a Hello World app and master the basics of Forge development.

[Read the docs](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/tutorials-and-guides/)

New

### Build on Teamwork Graph

Build Forge connectors that feed your data into Atlassian's context graph and apps that leverage its power. Your data becomes searchable, actionable, and AI-ready across the platform.

[Extend the graph](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/teamwork-graph/)[Explore the graph](https://www.teamworkgraph.com/)

![Image 9: Teamwork Graph visualization](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/teamwork-graph.svg)

## Create at the speed of AI

Innovate faster on the Atlassian platform with our native AI capabilities

![Image 10: Rovo Agents icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Rovo2.svg)

#### Rovo Agents

Create AI teammates that seamlessly integrate with your Jira and Confluence workflows.

[See docs](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/extend-atlassian-products-with-a-forge-rovo-agent/)

![Image 11: Rovo Dev CLI icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Develop.svg)

#### Rovo Dev CLI

Use natural language prompts to perform complex development tasks right from your command line.

[See docs](https://support.atlassian.com/rovo/docs/use-rovo-dev-cli/)

![Image 12: Atlassian MCP server icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/AceRichIcon.svg)

#### Atlassian MCP server

Build a secure, scalable bridge between Atlassian and external AI solutions.

[See docs](https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-rovo-mcp-server/docs/use-atlassian-rovo-mcp-server/)

### Introducing Studio

Describe what you need in plain English. Studio transforms your ideas into production-ready Forge apps, agents, and automations. No code required. Deploy directly to Jira, Confluence, and beyond.

![Image 13: Develop with Forge](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/AIPoweredCode.svg)

![Image 14: Developer community illustration](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/learningIllustration.svg)

## Collaborate with the community

Learn from thousands of developers building on Atlassian. Ask questions and share solutions in the Developer Community. Get best practices from Atlassian experts.

[Explore the community](https://community.developer.atlassian.com/)[Explore the case studies](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/developer)
